query_zh: 查找需要驾驶员明显减速、制动或避让的事件。
reviewer_role: Adversarial qualitative review by the research agent; not independent human adjudication and not semantic ground truth.

information_boundary.inputs: The frozen 2 fps chronological contact sheets only. Selected full-resolution 2 fps frames were inspected when sheet scale was ambiguous.
information_boundary.old_query_labels: Known only as preregistered sampling strata; not used as outcomes or truth for this query.

limitations: Sparse frames do not directly measure ego speed, braking, steering, or optical flow.
A visible road user or traffic control is not sufficient unless the sampled clip supports a marked ego response.
Unknown is retained when the response or causal timing cannot be established from the sampled visual evidence.
Review disagreement identifies a contradiction candidate for adjudication; it is not automatically an oracle error.

comparison_policy.model_high_confidence_relevant_consensus: Both identical 2 fps base calls parse successfully, label the clip relevant, and report high confidence.
comparison_policy.review_contradiction: The frozen review labels the clip not_relevant with medium or high confidence.
comparison_policy.unknown_handling: A frozen unknown never counts as a contradiction or a negative.
comparison_policy.single_contradiction: REVIEW_REQUIRED; the preflight cannot pass without independent adjudication.
comparison_policy.systematic_failure: FAIL when at least two contradiction candidates occur across at least two videos.
comparison_policy.same_video_cluster: Two or more contradiction candidates confined to one video remain REVIEW_REQUIRED, not systematic failure.
comparison_policy.zero_contradictions: The adversarial screen passes, subject to all separately frozen numeric gates.

reviews.label: not_relevant
reviews.evidence: Daytime urban driving with a white van offset to the left; no sampled road user, obstacle, or control visibly requires a marked ego response.
reviews.uncertainty: Sparse frames cannot exclude mild speed adjustment.

reviews.label: unknown
reviews.cause: A scooter or cyclist appears near the right edge while ego follows a red car.
reviews.evidence: The edge road user changes apparent position late in the clip, but the contact sheet does not establish entry into the ego path or a marked driver response.
reviews.uncertainty: Motion and lateral clearance are ambiguous at 2 fps.

reviews.label: relevant
reviews.cause: Scooters and pedestrians occupy or approach the night roadway near the ego path.
reviews.evidence: Multiple vulnerable road users become close to the forward path, supporting a marked cautious speed or path response.
reviews.uncertainty: Exact causal onset and ego maneuver are not directly observed.

reviews.label: relevant
reviews.cause: A pedestrian occupies/crosses the roadway while a scooter is directly ahead.
reviews.evidence: The pedestrian and scooter are visibly close to the ego path in the middle of the clip and require a marked cautious response.
reviews.uncertainty: The relative contribution of pedestrian versus scooter cannot be separated from frames alone.

reviews.label: not_relevant
reviews.evidence: Steady divided-road travel behind a distant vehicle; no sampled conflict or marked-response trigger is visible.

reviews.label: not_relevant
reviews.evidence: Ordinary multi-lane approach behind a white lead vehicle under green control with no visible conflict.

reviews.label: unknown
reviews.cause: Cross traffic is visible in a broad intersection.
reviews.evidence: The ego vehicle traverses an intersection and other vehicles appear, but sampled frames do not establish an immediate conflict or marked response.
reviews.uncertainty: Traffic-control phase and relative motion are insufficiently clear.

reviews.label: not_relevant
reviews.evidence: Urban boulevard travel continues behind traffic; a black sedan changes apparent lane position, but no sampled pedestrian crossing or marked ego-path threat is visible.
reviews.uncertainty: The sedan's relative motion could imply an unobserved mild adjustment.

reviews.label: unknown
reviews.cause: Traffic queues near a downstream signal late in the clip.
reviews.evidence: The ego vehicle approaches downstream traffic, but frames do not establish whether a noticeable slowdown begins within this unit.
reviews.uncertainty: The response may straddle the unit boundary and speed is not measured.

reviews.label: relevant
reviews.cause: A red signal requires stopping while a cyclist and pedestrians cross the ego path.
reviews.evidence: The red signal and multiple crossing road users are clearly visible as ego approaches the crosswalk.
reviews.uncertainty: Frames do not distinguish braking intensity from an already-planned stop.

reviews.label: relevant
reviews.cause: An oncoming cyclist approaches along the ego side of a narrow street while parked and lead vehicles constrain clearance.
reviews.evidence: The cyclist grows substantially in scale near the left portion of the available lane, supporting a cautious speed/clearance response.
reviews.uncertainty: Exact lane geometry and the ego response are not directly measured.

reviews.label: not_relevant
reviews.evidence: The clip begins at a controlled intersection and ego proceeds after the signal changes; no new marked-response trigger is visible within the sampled interval.
reviews.uncertainty: Any prior stopping response likely began before the clip.
